title: OpenAI plans to deploy at least 10 GW of Nvidia systems

sources.quote: OpenAI and NVIDIA today announced a letter of intent for a landmark strategic partnership to deploy at least 10 gigawatts of NVIDIA systems for OpenAI's next-generation AI infrastructure to train and run its next generation of models on the path to deploying superintelligence.

explain: OpenAI signed a letter of intent (a non-binding plan) to use at least 10 gigawatts of Nvidia computers, with the first gigawatt due in the second half of 2026. No price was given; Nvidia separately said it intends to invest up to $100B in OpenAI as the systems are deployed, so money flows both ways.
